title: Google's factory image
body: The phone's Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, sound, camera and modem need files that only Google may hand out. They are in Google's "factory image" for the phone. Omarchy Mobile does not host them or pass them on.
This phone's bootloader and baseband match Google's build TEST.260101.001, which release 2026.01.02 was tested with.
(Also in the list with the same two versions, which can't be told apart from here: TEST.260101.001.A1. TEST.260101.001 is the tested one, and the one used.)
You accepted Google's terms for build TEST.260101.001 on 2026-11-12 at 14:03 UTC. The installer keeps that for this run only and sends it nowhere.

The installer downloads the image from Google's own server, dl.google.com, to this computer: cheetah-test.260101.001-factory-31c2322a.zip, about 0.0 MB. It then checks the file's size and SHA-256 against the release's signed list, and uses nothing of the file before that.
If you already saved that file from Google's page, you can hand it to the installer instead.
problem: The download from Google's server stopped before it was complete: 20000 of 49152 bytes had arrived (connection reset). You can try again.
footer: The file comes from Google and stays on this computer. Nothing of it is sent anywhere.
